{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if they are all in one channel or spread out
table = pd.crosstab(qa_orders['channel'], qa_orders['customer_segment'])
print("QA order distribution by channel and segment:")
print(table)"}
